questionsToConsider: Do most messages you get concern orders? If so, would a separate returns form serve customers better?
Where does a customer find their order number, and does the hint under that question say so?
Do you have answers to common questions you could link to in the greeting?
Can your team take calls, or should replies be by email only?
guide.howToUseResponses: Filter the dashboard by topic each day so order and return questions go to whoever can look up orders. Reply to the question in the message first, then add anything else. When the same question keeps coming in, answer it on your website and link to that page from the greeting.
customizeSteps: Change the topic list to match the questions your inbox really gets, keeping the order and return options if you sell online.
Edit the order number hint to say exactly where your customers can find it.
Embed the form on your contact page and link it from order confirmation emails.

faqs.q: What should a customer contact form include?
faqs.a: A name, a reply address, what the message is about and space for the question. For an online shop, add an order number field so your team doesn't have to ask for it.

faqs.q: How do I cut down on back-and-forth emails with customers?
faqs.a: Ask for the details you always end up chasing in the form itself. Here, order and return questions ask for the order number and photos up front, so the first reply can be an answer rather than a request for more information.

faqs.q: Can customers send photos of a damaged item?
faqs.a: Yes. Customers asking about an order or return can upload photos, which saves a round of emails before you can help.

faqs.q: Can I embed this contact form on my website?
faqs.a: Yes. Use this template to copy it into your account, edit the questions, then embed it on any page or share it as a link.
